name: yamori
description: Work in numbered pseudocode beside your editor: read, plan and edit steps; your agent updates the code. No API key: uses your Claude Code or Codex login. Python, JS/TS, Go, Rust and Java.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Read, explain and plan in Restricted Mode; planning uses bundled read-only project lookups. Running code or applying a plan requires workspace trust. Project executable settings and language-service lookups are not used in Restricted Mode.

commands.title: Yamori: Read a Folder or Project
Yamori: Map Stages from Entry Point

yamori.codexPath.description: Optional absolute path to Codex CLI. Otherwise detected automatically.

yamori.claudePath.description: Optional absolute path to Claude Code CLI. Otherwise detected automatically, including the copy inside Claude Desktop.

yamori.tokenBudgetPerFilePerDay.description: Warn before writing or updating Logic when the estimated input would exceed this file’s daily token budget. Counts reported cached reads. Zero disables warnings.

yamori.refinementSteps.description: Maximum refinement steps. In File Flow, review a card explicitly or update a block with a linked risk. Opening a file only generates its missing cards. Reviewers check uncertainty and reading cost before keeping a faithful rewrite. 0 turns refinement off.

yamori.parallelRequests.description: How many requests write one Logic explanation at the same time. Yamori splits a bigger file locally (no AI) into parts made of whole functions and classes; Each request gets its assigned source, a file outline, and relevant context. 1 writes the whole file in one request.

yamori.generateCardsOnOpen.description: Fill all missing Logic cards when you open a file in Yamori. Cached cards are reused. Turn off to generate a missing card only when you open it.

yamori.reviewModel.description: Model for the reviewers and the review rewrite, which run in the background after the draft is shown. auto uses one tier below your writer, never above it: Sonnet under Opus or Claude's default, or Codex's balanced catalog model (Terra) under its default; if you already chose a smaller writer, reviews use it. main uses your writer's model; or enter an exact model ID.

yamori.planBudget.description: Most tokens of project knowledge sent to the AI when drafting a plan in the Project guide's Plan tab. The slice is outlines and the few pseudocode blocks that match the goal, never source files; it is cut at this limit and the panel says what was left out.

enumDescriptions: Compatibility alias for main: one draft with your selected model, no automatic escalation.
Use your selected model for one draft.
Use the quick model for one draft. Retrying or improving requires an explicit request.
yamori.planModel.description: Which model drafts plans. main (default) and legacy auto use your selected model once; fast uses the quick model once. No automatic second draft or fallback model.

yamori.agentTools.description: Allow workspace lookups from the Logic Ask or Edit box in trusted projects. Pseudocode generation uses scoped context without calling tools. Plan and Work manage their own tool access.

yamori.cache.description: Save pseudocode on this computer and show it immediately when you reopen an unchanged file, with no model request. A changed file keeps saved text for blocks whose source did not change. Turn off to generate again every time. Yamori: Clear Cached Explanations deletes saved explanations either way. Saved explanations and name flows are kept under about 64 MB; the least recently opened ones are dropped first.

enumDescriptions: About 2 seconds after you save, update only the blocks whose code changed. Unchanged blocks are reused from the cache.
Mark changed blocks Needs update and wait for Update all.
About 2 seconds after you save a changed file, write every block again.
yamori.autoRefresh.markdownDescription: Update pseudocode after you save a file open in Yamori. Rapid saves are combined, a newer save cancels an update in progress, and nothing runs for large files or during a git rebase or merge.

yamori.codeLens.description: Show Yamori's block titles above the code they explain (and an Explain link in mapped files that have no explanation yet). No AI is used.

yamori.autoNotes.description: Write AI notes (file purposes, project terms and a project overview) automatically once a folder is mapped, when you open its files, and after rescans. Waits until an AI is set up; asks first for projects with more than 120 files. Notes are tool-free requests and never run project code, so they also work in Restricted Mode.

yamori.fastModel.description: Model for quick jobs: the Logic file gist, AI notes, the Overview level (and the Overview written alongside Logic) and picking blocks to review. auto uses Claude Haiku, or the fast model in Codex's catalog; off uses your main model for everything; or enter an exact model ID. Logic explanations and reviews always use your main model.

yamori.pythonPath.description: Python interpreter for running a function's unit tests in the explanation (Run with a test). Empty uses the Python extension's interpreter for the project, then a .venv, then python3. Real runs execute your project's test code; Yamori asks once per folder and never runs code in Restricted Mode.

yamori.pseudocodeMirror.description: Keep plain-text copies of explained files' pseudocode in <project>/.yamori/pseudocode/, with an index of the project, for agents that read files directly. Off by default: Yamori's agent tools do not need it. Turning it on keeps .yamori/ out of git through .git/info/exclude. Off in Restricted Mode.

yamori.selectionQuestions.description: Show a native inline question field after highlighting code. Sends the question and exact selected snapshot to read-only Yamori chat only when you press Ask Yamori. Disable to use the selection context-menu action or keyboard shortcut instead.

perRun.description: Most tokens (input, cached and output) one stage run may use. 0 means no limit.

perDay.description: Most tokens stage work may use per day. 0 means no limit.

yamori.tokenBudget.markdownDescription: Token budgets for stage work (mapping, updates, review summaries, agent requests). A run that would go over stops and shows **Needs update** instead of spending. Every call is listed in the stage screen's Activity.

yamori.stages.autoUpdate.markdownDescription: After saves settle (about 2 seconds, longer while an agent edits many files), update only the stages whose code changed: one cheap-model call per affected stage. Off: mark them **Needs update** and wait for **Update changed**.

yamori.obsidian.vaultPath.markdownDescription: Folder of your Obsidian vault. Stage notes, file notes and the change log go to `<vault>/Yamori/<repo>/`. Empty: they go to `.yamori/notes/` in the project. Yamori rewrites only the section between `<!-- yamori:start -->` and `<!-- yamori:end -->`; what you write elsewhere is never overwritten.
